sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Lightning-Fast, On-Device, Multilingual TTS
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 is a 99M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model from Supertone. Runs on CPU via ONNX Runtime. No GPU. No cloud. No API. 31 languages.

sources.title: Supertone/supertonic-3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: smdesai/supertonic-3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: What's New in Supertonic 3 31 languages: expanded from the 5-language Supertonic 2 release. More stable reading: fewer repeat and skip failures, especially on short and long utterances. Higher speaker similarity: improved similarity across the shared-language set compared with Supertonic 2.

sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Models — The AI Bench
sources.snippet: ← All models MODEL · SUPERTONE · LIGHTWEIGHT (ON-DEVICE) Supertonic 3 A lightweight on-device TTS that runs entirely locally through ONNX Runtime — no cloud call for synthesis. Supertonic 3 expands the open-weight release from 5 to 31 languages, improves reading stability, and cuts repeat/skip failures. `pip install supertonic` and synthesize immediately with selectable voice styles ...

sources.title: Faster and more accurate across 31 languages — introducing Supertonic 3!
sources.snippet: ‍ Wrapping up Supertonic 3 is Supertone's lightweight, high-efficiency TTS model — built around more languages, more stable reading quality, and faster generation. If Sona 2 is the model that shines in rich expressiveness and emotional delivery, Supertonic 3 is the choice for fast, efficient multilingual voice generation.
